description: A Blazor component class for displaying toast notifications, handling show/hide events, styling based on toast level, and disposal of event handlers.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: Blazor component for displaying toast notifications, manages visibility, styles, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the component and subscribes to toast show/hide events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles the event to display a toast message with styling based on toast level.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Handles the event to hide the toast notification.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Sets styling and heading based on the toast level and message.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from events to prevent memory leaks.
